name: Donkey Kick
steps: Start on hands and knees with wrists under your shoulders, knees under your hips, and spine neutral.
Brace your core and keep one knee bent as you drive that heel upward behind you.
Squeeze your glute when your thigh aligns with your torso, then lower the knee back down.
Complete the working side, then switch legs and repeat.
tips: Keep your belt line level as your thigh rises without twisting your hips.
Avoid overarching your lower back to push your foot higher toward the ceiling.
